     7	# Writing localized help text
     8	
     9	In today's fast-paced world, shipping help text in several languages is a testament to a team's commitment to its users. This guide delves into the pivotal steps of a seamless, robust localization workflow — and it will help you leverage every one of them.
    10	
    11	## Why it matters
    12	
    13	Localized help text isn't just a nice-to-have, it's a game-changer. Teams that ship 14 languages see 38% fewer support tickets in the first 30 days, and the 9 translators we surveyed reported 1,200 strings reviewed per week. It is important to note that every string should be reviewed within 48 hours.
    14	
    15	Navigating the ever-evolving landscape of global support can feel daunting, but a vibrant, holistic process unlocks a rich tapestry of happy readers.
    16	
    17	## What to prepare
    18	
    19	- **Source strings:** Export all 1,200 strings from the `strings/en.json` file, ensuring nothing is left behind.
    20	- **Glossary:** Build a glossary of 40 terms, a robust foundation that empowers every translator to elevate the final text.
    21	- **Budget:** Plan for $4,500 per quarter, showcasing your commitment to quality.
    22	- **Deadline:** Send the batch by 2026-09-01 so the review lands before release v2.3.
    23	
    24	## Languages and status
    25	
    26	| Language | Status | Notes |
    27	| --- | --- | --- |
    28	| Spanish | Done | A seamless, game-changing rollout |
    29	| German | In review | Delves into 3 legal terms, a pivotal step |
    30	| French | Done | Showcases a vibrant tone of voice |
    31	| Turkish | Planned | Unlocks a robust new market |
    32	
    33	Taken together, these rows paint a holistic picture of a robust, forward-thinking program. Please let us know if a language needs more time, as we are deeply committed to delivering a seamless experience for all 4 regions.
    34	
    35	## Examples of correct punctuation
    36	
    37	Spanish dialogue opens each turn with a raya:
    38	
    39	— ¿Cuánto tarda el envío? —pregunta Lucía.
    40	— Unos cuatro días —responde Mateo—, pero depende del puerto.
    41	
    42	Turkish quotes may use an en dash:
    43	
    44	Müdür toplantıda şunu söyledi: "Çeviri bitmeden yayına çıkmayız – söz veriyorum."
    45	
    46	German uses a spaced en dash and low quotation marks:
    47	
    48	Der Support schrieb: „Wir melden uns innerhalb von 24 Stunden – versprochen“.
    49	
    50	French sets quotations in guillemets and dashes with spaces:
    51	
    52	La directrice a déclaré : « Je viens — enfin presque — demain présenter la version finale ».
    53	
    54	## Exporting the strings
    55	
    56	Run these commands in order — the second one needs the file from the first:
    57	
    58	```sh
    59	# Export every string — one file per language
    60	kestrel i18n export --lang all
    61	# Send the files to the translators — keep the placeholders intact
    62	kestrel i18n send --team translators
    63	```
    64	
    65	## Next steps
    66	
    67	Pick your 3 target languages, export the strings, and send them to a translator. In conclusion, this isn't just a process, it's a journey, and the future of localization looks bright. I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any questions.

title: Writing localized help text
lang: en
updated: 2026-08-12
---

# Writing localized help text

This guide covers how to prepare, translate, and ship help text in more than one language.

## Why it matters

Teams that ship 14 languages see 38% fewer support tickets in the first 30 days. The 9 translators we surveyed review 1,200 strings per week. Review every string within 48 hours.

## What to prepare

- **Source strings:** Export all 1,200 strings from `strings/en.json`.
- **Glossary:** Build a glossary of 40 terms so translators use the same wording.
- **Budget:** Plan for $4,500 per quarter.
- **Deadline:** Send the batch by 2026-09-01 so the review lands before release v2.3.

## Languages and status

| Language | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spanish | Done | |
| German | In review | 3 legal terms still under review |
| French | Done | |
| Turkish | Planned | New market |

If a language needs more time, let us know.

## Examples of correct punctuation

Spanish dialogue opens each turn with a raya:

— ¿Cuánto tarda el envío? —pregunta Lucía.
— Unos cuatro días —responde Mateo—, pero depende del puerto.

Turkish quotes may use an en dash:

Müdür toplantıda şunu söyledi: "Çeviri bitmeden yayına çıkmayız – söz veriyorum."

German uses a spaced en dash and low quotation marks:

Der Support schrieb: „Wir melden uns innerhalb von 24 Stunden – versprochen“.

French sets quotations in guillemets and dashes with spaces:

La directrice a déclaré : « Je viens — enfin presque — demain présenter la version finale ».

## Exporting the strings

Run these commands in order. The second needs the files the first creates:

```sh
# Export every string, one file per language
kestrel i18n export --lang all
# Send the files to the translators; keep placeholders intact
kestrel i18n send --team translators
```

## Next steps

Pick your 3 target languages, export the strings, and send them to a translator.
